test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: While selling an item, the difference between selling it at 11% profit and 13% loss is Rs. 204. What is the cost price of the item?
solution:
**Given:**

The difference between selling at 11% profit and 13% loss = Rs. 204

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price (CP) × (1 + Profit%)

Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price (CP) × (1 - Loss%)
